mapper.select: SELECT channel_id FROM tc_payment_attempt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND merchant_request_no=#{reference}
SELECT a.channel_id FROM tc_payment_receipt r JOIN tc_payment_attempt a ON a.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND a.id=r.attempt_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.receipt_no=#{reference}

SELECT a.channel_id FROM tc_payment_refund_hold h JOIN tc_payment_receipt r ON r.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND r.id=h.receipt_id JOIN tc_payment_attempt a ON a.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND a.id=r.attempt_id WHERE h.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND h.refund_no=#{reference}
